notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Out!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to All Followers of Bastet![/b]

While you were putting your hearts and souls into your duties to the cat-folk -which can be summarised as an unending form of selfless servitude, we were working on Patch 1.1 for "Cats and the Other Lives"! 

Here is a list of fixes (Contains mild spoilers!):

[list]
[*] The gameplay of the Final Chase Scene has been improved. It is now easier to jump on the walls and the sequence should run more smoothly for most of our players.
[*] We have made a final audio mix to the game balancing a number of sound effects while making some inaudible ones audible again.
[*] The issues related to some hints that are not turning off have been solved.
[*] The issue of Aspen walking on air at the manor corridor has been solved.
[*] The issue of the camera not working properly in the Haunted Christmas Uriel and Lorraine Cutscene has been fixed.
[*] The gameplay of the Nuñez Vacuum Cleaner Scene has been improved.
[*] Minor Changes in the Credits section.
[/list]

Until we meet again, enjoy the patch!

[b]Team Cultic[/b]

notes.title: GIVE AWAY!!! - Kitties and Hoodies
notes.content:
We Greet All the Obedient Servants of the Cat-folk!

We are organizing a [b]Give Away Campaign [/b]that would require some creativity on your side because frankly, we are tired of being creative for you all the time and wanted to be the judges for once :)

We’ll be giving away the physical gifts you see below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/f1a1bdee1b60f227b48287f3def70415512e4a97.png[/img]

An [b]Artbook[/b], a [b]deck [/b]of [b]Mason Family Cards [/b]and the mysterious [b]Aaru Pamphlet[/b].

All you need to do is:

[list]
[*] Turn yourself into a [b]cultist[/b]! (Hoodies, bathrobes, scarves, anything would work!)
[*] And take a [b]pic[/b] with your [b]cat[/b] in this glorious outfit. (Can be horror themed, comedic, anything in between!)
[*] Tag us on Instagram: [b]@catsandtheotherlives[/b]
[*] Enter the hashtag: [b]#KittiesandHoodies[/b]
[*] Share it as a post on [b]Instagram[/b]!
[/list]
Here are some examples:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/80c0625b11c435a16c75e887e279e719503cd18b.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/aaf7cfb2e3d03310b117d1723b9562190656e82a.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/9f43ab31df90957775ba5e7b6ef42390a04faad2.jpg[/img]

You have one week to serve your goddess Bastet with pictures of indescribable cuteness.

Here is the [b]Instagram[/b] post of the campaign:
https://www.instagram.com/catsandtheotherlives/?hl=en

Let the games begin!

[i][u]PS[/u]: We also have released the Steam Trading Cards and Badges. So you better start COLLECTING!!! [/i]

[b][i]Team Cultic[/i][/b]

notes.title: Autumn Sale and Hotfix!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to All Followers of Bastet![/b]

We’d like to thank everyone who played CatOL and supported us during the launch!

We have started with a [b]Very Positive[/b] score of [b]97%[/b] thanks to your beautiful reviews!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/2ca6949c614f6882aecedef9a21911621f159750.jpg[/img]

We have just shared a [b]Hotfix [/b]for those of you who have experienced the [b]Continue [/b]game [b]freeze [/b]issue. All you need to do is [b]update [/b]the game in your Steam Library and continue playing!

We also want to share that we will be keeping our [b]20% Launch Discount[/b] throughout the [b]Autumn Sale[/b] so it might be a good time to become a domestic cat and dive into the mysteries of a broken family…

Thank you!

[i]Team Cultic[/i]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE: MAY
notes.content:
[b]To all the Cats and Other Life Forms![/b]

Another month has passed in the blink of an eye. Once again, we're here to share some exciting news and development notes with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/44fe5b568a2b185e3bbf2c4a5ad03838dd22a03a.gif[/img]

The demo version of “Cats and the Other Lives” will strike back at the upcoming Steam Next Fest in June. If you haven’t played the previous demo we believe this is a great chance to explore what CatOL has in store for its players thanks to the improvements in user experience, narrative sequencing and some new scenes added just for the demo. If you have played the previous demo, it might be wise to be a little bit more patient and wait for the full release because it is APPROACHING!

If you play our demo please be sure to treat us with your valuable feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/6f4c7485f1afc8bfaba1936cc1fea7e0a5036982.png[/img]

After two years, we are finally in the development of the very last scene of Cats and the Other Lives! Soon we will be going through a rigorous polishing and QA process as a team until we are sure our game is optimized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/edd93e0d5d5738862cc05347f8829aa8a4bd80b4.gif[/img]

[i]“Some people won’t get their hands on Aspen.”[/i]

All the texts of the game are also completed and are now awaiting proofreading, after which localization batches will be sent soon to be translated into Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/0140a4cfdc609500c8cca1040e2aac9c3a0a46b3.png[/img]

Oh and we've also made UI improvements for large screen resolutions and lots of major and minor UX improvements along the way.

Stay tuned for more news and updates!

[b]Team Cultic[/b]

notes.title: Dev Update: March
notes.content:
[b]To all the Cats and Other Life Forms![/b]

We present to you our new development update, let's take a look at what's been cooking in the kitchen this month.

[b]New Gameplay Feature[/b]
Aspen can now look at the memories of the past through a new window while visiting the rooms of the mansion. This is a new feature that will greatly strengthen our narrative language by expanding our storytelling tools in addition to our existing flashback mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/99c7f7a82b3626fc7f6ce3d507e584f41e985808.gif[/img]

[b]Animation Improvements[/b]
We have made some improvements to better convey the complex emotional states of the members of the Mason family to you by improving our animations and by doing so we hope to let our characters to better express their feelings through their body language and gestures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/598456c96f8a158261cb366e8881dcb771db4dbd.gif[/img]

In addition to feature improvements, we continue to work on optimization to ensure that our game offers the smoothest possible experience.

See you in our next update!

[b]Team Cultic[/b]

tags.feature: Aspen can now look at the memories of the past through a new window while visiting the rooms of the mansion.

notes.title: Dev Update: February
notes.content:
To all the Cats and Other Life Forms!

From now on we will be sharing a development update with you each month until release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/571dac48018caa06e88416cb7e79e42727106904.png[/img]

As of now, we have finished the second chapter of [b]CatOL[/b] and started the development of the third and final chapter.

Now let's take a look at what we have achieved so far and what lies ahead of us:

[list]
[*] All the unique features of the game are complete. All that remains now, is utilizing our current tools and systems to support our remaining content in the best possible way. 

[*] All the essential rooms of the mansion and their related assets are complete. The lighting setups to represent different stages of the day are also 8o% complete. You can see an example of the process below:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/4278015669069a9e4a7dad26a4c1b9b9de97266d.gif[/img]

The whole story structure is complete and 75% of the script is done and proofread.  
The groundwork for the localization systems has been completed and is awaiting our translators. 

The story and gameplay content of the final chapter is still in progress. Since the third chapter consists of many of our most dramatic and intense scenes, a feverish animation work continues.

Briefly, in these final months of production, all our efforts are concentrated on making the right mark in the hearts and minds of our players. 

Of course, you will be the judge of this when the game comes out :)

Here are some of the new features that have been integrated into our game:

[b]Hint System:[/b]

Developed a hint system for players who have difficulties during gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/dd2350cc47a2868d3c3c6bdf98e4cd74612e099e.gif[/img]

[b]Improved Movement System:[/b]
Based on your feedback, the walking and running functions have been developed as a proximity-based movement system, so that when we click close to Aspen, it walks to the point and when we click further away, it goes there running. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/0fa31ae740c48ee783f43a37ffb680d59e260eb9.gif[/img]

There is also now a movement function to climb vertically in some sequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/30371f477c31587108d6bdc661a7a8bd55acb941.gif[/img]

[b]Inventory System:[/b]
Since the main character of our game is a cat, a single object inventory system has been developed so that Aspen can carry only one object at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38229487/f3c13a19a6d5e07e33098beb43d47d3fa4172e1d.png[/img]

See you in our next update!

[b]Team Cultic[/b]
